{{Quote|Fenrol Jarkey wanted to smuggle some spice into Theed, and I was going to help him sell it. But now he's dead, the stupid drunk.|Derm Worrit, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FaEM" />}}
'''Derm Worrit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] thug of [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|criminal empire]] who operated out of the [[Borvo Bunker]] outside of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he planned to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] with [[Fenrol Jarkey]].<ref name="SWG:FaEM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> agents of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Royal Security Police Force|Violent Crimes Division]] interrogated him about his relationship with [[Hunnos Jarkey]], a wanted murderer.<ref name="SWG:FaEM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Derm Worrit was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Derm Worrit was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
